questions.qtext: Which one of the following statement is FALSE for streamlines in a steady incompressible flow?

options.text: Stream function has a constant value along a streamline.
Two streamlines cannot intersect each other.
Converging straight streamlines pattern indicates convective normal acceleration in the flow direction.
Tangent drawn at any point on a streamline represents the direction of the instantaneous velocity at that point.

questions.solution:
(c)
Converging straight streamlines pattern indicates convective tangential deceleration in the flow direction.

questions.qtext: With increase in temperature, which of the following statement(s) regarding viscosity is/are CORRECT?

options.text: the dynamic viscosity of a gas increases
the dynamic viscosity of a liquid decreases
the kinematic viscosity of a gas increases
the kinematic viscosity of a liquid increases

questions.solution:
(a, b, c)
• With increase in temperature cohesive forces between the liquid molecules decreases resulting in decrease in viscosity of liquids.
• With increase in temperature molecular collisions between the molecules of gases increases resulting in increase in viscosity of gases.
• Kinematic viscosity of liquid may increase or decrease.
